Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped at a red signal in the left lane of a major roadway in Sugar Land, Texas, when the rear of the
vehicle was struck by a sedan operated by Driver 2. Driver 2 told me the brakes were applied too late on a wet
pavement surface and admitted the impact was his responsibility. Two independent witnesses at the intersection
gave statements that matched this account, and both said the collision occurred just as Driver 1 described.
Photographs taken at the scene show a crushed rear bumper, a displaced trunk lid and a cracked tail lamp assembly,
damage consistent with the speed and direction of the impact. I found no indication of prior body damage or repairs to
the vehicle. The Passenger was seated in the front right position and was confirmed by both Driver 1 and the
witnesses as present during the crash. Driver 1 reported a head injury and was transproted for evaluation with
symptoms consistent with a concussion. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle.
</page>
